name: Search1API
description: Remote MCP server for Search1API. Exposes live web search, news, page reading, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as tools for AI agents.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search the web
tools.description: Search the live public web when the user needs current information, sources, or research. Returns citable results with id, title, URL, and text. Each result includes a URL that can be read in full.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

search_service.description: Search engine to use; choose one only when it matches the user's source intent

crawl_results.description: Number of top results to retrieve as full pages. Each successful page retrieval adds 1 credit to the base 1-credit search request

include_sites.description: Domains to include when the user explicitly scopes the search

exclude_sites.description: Domains to exclude from the search

time_range.description: Optional recency window for time-sensitive searches

tools.name: news
tools.title: Search current news
tools.description: Search current news when the user asks about recent events, announcements, or coverage. Returns citable article results with title, URL, snippet, and optional extracted text.

max_results.description: Maximum number of articles to return

crawl_results.description: Number of top articles to retrieve as full pages. Each successful retrieval adds 1 credit to the base 1-credit news request

time_range.description: Optional recency window; use day for breaking news

tools.name: crawl
tools.title: Read a web page
tools.description: Extract the readable title and full text from a public URL supplied by the user or returned by search.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to retrieve

tools.name: sitemap
tools.title: Discover links on a site
tools.description: Discover related public links from a page or domain when the user wants to explore a site's structure or available pages.

url.description: Public page or domain URL whose links should be discovered

tools.name: trending
tools.title: Explore trending topics
tools.description: List currently trending repositories or stories from GitHub or Hacker News when the user asks what is popular now.

search_service.description: Platform whose trending items should be returned

max_results.description: Maximum number of trending items to return
